channel.title: Buying in SeaFlower blog
channel.description: Everything buyers ask about SeaFlower in Bradenton, FL: builders, floor plans, pricing, HOA and CDD fees, location, schools, flood zones and the buying process, from a former builder insider who represents buyers.
